title: Doors I Walked Through to Reach DEV
why_read: A personal, self-congratulatory reflection on joining a Dev.to community team with no technical content.
analysis: This post is a personal narrative about the author's journey into a Dev.to writer collective called DEVengers, focused on community belonging and content milestones. It contains no technical substance, code, or engineering insight relevant to a software engineering digest. It's purely a community/motivational blog post aimed at Dev.to's internal audience rather than external technical readers.
